=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:_inject_token_into_url (lines 3040-3055) and _resolve_origin_url (lines 3074-3087) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Git authentication embeds GH_TOKEN directly in HTTPS clone/push URLs instead of using per-process http.extraHeader authentication.
  WHY: Tokens persist in subprocess argv, `/proc`, temporary clone `.git/config`, exception traces, and Git diagnostics, violating the established credential-handling pattern.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:_memory_force_tick_remote_url (lines 542-588) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Force-tick remote URLs embed tokens in the HTTPS userinfo component.
  WHY: Tokens can persist in clone metadata and leak through process listings, Git errors, logs, and diagnostics.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:normalize_path (lines 240-247) and emit_context (lines 536-716) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The sensitive-path rejection guard was removed, allowing credential-bearing files such as `.git/config`, `.env*`, `.npmrc`, `.pypirc`, `.aws/credentials`, and `.docker/config.json` to be read into targeted context.
  WHY: Secrets and Git credentials can cross into reviewer/editor prompts, prompt caches, and model-provider logs.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:normalize_path (lines 240-247) and emit_context (lines 536-716) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `MAX_TARGET_PATHS`, `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES`, and the output summary reserve were removed.
  WHY: Large or attacker-influenced path lists can produce unbounded marker/output text and violate the documented `TARGETED_FILE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES` contract.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:line 1989 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The unguarded `[judge-fix]` push still calls the removed `git_with_github_auth` helper.
  WHY: The push fails with `command not found`, so the committed review-blocked fix never reaches the remote branch.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:lines 2382-2383 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The baseline-branch push path falls through to bare `git push` after the removed helper fails the availability guard.
  WHY: Bare pushes lack authentication for private repositories, so baseline branch creation silently fails.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:removed function `git_with_github_auth` (was at lines 464-483) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: An existing helper identifier used by live callers was removed without an alias or replacement.
  WHY: Remaining callers receive `command not found` or fall back to unauthenticated Git operations, breaking the authenticated judge-fix path.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:lines 62-67 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The `pre_assembled_static.txt` preservation branch checks the index instead of `HEAD` and restores only the worktree, omitting `--staged`.
  WHY: A staged modification or deletion survives into the implementation commit despite the preservation log message.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:lines 29-38 (imports), 710, 712, 772, 775 (uses) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test module still imports and uses removed `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path` symbols.
  WHY: Pytest raises `ImportError` during collection and the targeted-context test suite cannot run.
- tests/test_git_auth_hygiene.py:lines 51-56 and 96-98 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The tests require `_memory_git` authentication calls and reject token-bearing URLs that the production changes removed or introduced.
  WHY: The Git authentication hygiene contract tests fail against the current source.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:memory_ensure_branch (lines 137-183) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `memory_ensure_branch` assigns `local token="${GH_TOKEN:-}"` but performs bare `git ls-remote` and `git push` after `_memory_git` was removed.
  WHY: Private repositories and `persist-credentials: false` workflows cannot authenticate, so the `ai-memory` branch is never detected or created and failure is swallowed.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:setup_editor_isolation (lines 130-185) plus the fail-closed exits at lines 1923-1927 and 1953-1957 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Editor execution unconditionally requires passwordless `sudo`, a `nobody` user, and a detached workspace with no fallback.
  WHY: Runners lacking these prerequisites exit before invoking the editor, producing empty no-op review runs.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:emit_context (lines 536-716) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `abs_path.stat()` and `abs_path.read_bytes()` no longer have `OSError` handling.
  WHY: A file removed or made unreadable between `is_file()` and the read raises `FileNotFoundError` or `PermissionError` and aborts targeted-context construction.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:merge_with_followup successor block at lines 18094-18138 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Inconclusive successor lookup or failed deferred-gap issue creation now emits only `::warning::` and drops the previous Telegram warning and explicit untracked-gap handling.
  WHY: A merged deferred gap can remain untracked without operator notification.
- tests/test_review_semble_contract.py:188; also tests/test_review_autofix_merge_precheck.py:131-137; tests/test_review_rb_judge_reference_staging.py:93; tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:17860; tests/test_workflow_overlay_core.py:319 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Contract tests still require removed `.codex-workflow-src-main` fallbacks, the old clean exclusion, and the removed dependency-install step.
  WHY: CI contract assertions fail even though the workflow changes are intentional.
- README.md:Variables table row `TARGETED_FILE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES` and the surrounding prose on targeted-file-context bounds | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: README documents path-count and per-path byte bounds that the implementation no longer enforces.
  WHY: Operators and downstream tools rely on a false output-size contract.
